text: The days that followed. <break time="0.8s" /> Were a long strain. <break time="0.8s" /> For whenever the steward came into my cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> To tidy it. <break time="0.8s" /> My double had to slip into the bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> Or flatten himself behind my coats. <break time="0.8s" /> Once, as the steward opened the very bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> Where Leggatt stood hidden. <break time="0.8s" /> My heart nearly stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> But my double, crouching in the bath. <break time="0.8s" /> Somehow escaped his notice. <break time="0.8s" /> So intense was my double life. <break time="0.8s" /> That I began to speak in whispers. <break time="0.8s" /> Even on deck. <break time="0.8s" /> And my officers. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing their captain start at nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> Must have thought him. <break time="0.8s" /> Either ill or slightly mad. <break time="0.8s" /> Each order I gave. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to come from a divided mind. <break time="0.8s" /> Half of it attending to the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> And half to the silent man in my cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose fate depended entirely. <break time="0.8s" /> On my composure. <break time="0.8s" /> One night Leggatt told me. <break time="0.8s" /> In his calm whisper. <break time="0.8s" /> That he must leave the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he would never let himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Be taken ashore. <break time="0.8s" /> To face a judge and a jury. <break time="0.8s" /> He asked me instead. <break time="0.8s" /> To maroon him among the islands. <break time="0.8s" /> Off the Cambodian shore. <break time="0.8s" /> For he would rather wander the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> As an outcast. <break time="0.8s" /> Than be shut up again in any cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> As I came at night, so I shall go. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And though I protested. <break time="0.8s" /> That he might never be found. <break time="0.8s" /> I knew that he was right. <break time="0.8s" /> And that our secret could not last.
